newsitem.title: UK: MOTORCYCLING-FOGARTY WINS 40TH RACE TO HEAD TITLE CHASE.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-FOGARTY WINS 40TH RACE TO HEAD TITLE CHASE.

text.p: Briton Carl Fogarty claimed his 40th world superbike victory to take the championship lead after the third round on Sunday.

Fogarty, on a Ducati, opened an 11-point break on Honda rider Aaron Slight of New Zealand after easily winning the second race on the programme ahead of Italy's Pier-Francesco Chili, also on a Ducati.
Slight won the opening 25-lap contest on the two-race card, with Fogarty second 1.683 seconds behind.

Fogarty clinched his first win of the season to overtake American John Kocinski at the top of the standings. Kocinski, on a Honda, dropped to third behind Sunday's two winners after 10th and fifth-place finishes.

"It was great to win in front of my home fans -- a tremendous way to win my 40th race," said Fogarty, who has won two world titles with Ducati. "Mind you, after the two races today I feel 40 years of age."
